summary: A local news feature profiles seven innovative small businesses that opened in the community in autumn 2023, spanning sustainable fashion, virtual interior design, a speakeasy restaurant, woodworking, a pay-it-forward bookshop, a sensory spa and an energy-generating gym. Each profile gives the founders' motivations and what makes the concept distinctive. The common thread is passion-driven entrepreneurship that serves community and sustainability goals.
one_line: A local news roundup of seven innovative small businesses opened in 2023, from eco fashion and virtual design to a speakeasy restaurant and a human-powered gym.
key_facts: Emily Johnson opened 'Eco Apparel,' a sustainable fashion boutique on the corner of Maple Street, in September 2023; it sells clothing made from organic, recycled materials and collaborates with local artisans.
Emily Johnson said her business began around her kitchen table with a sewing machine, motivated by her frustration with waste in the fashion industry.

Kevin Hart and Julie Chen cofounded Decor Den, which officially opened on November 10, 2023, offering virtual interior design services in which customers can virtually tour their designed space and make real-time adjustments.
Chef Marco Petrillo opened 'Chef Marco's Secret Kitchen' on September 20, 2023, a speakeasy-themed restaurant inspired by the Prohibition era.
The entrance to Chef Marco's Secret Kitchen is hidden behind a bookcase in a small café, and diners must whisper the secret phrase of the day; the menu changes each week.

Sara Nguyen and Tom Hirsch opened 'Woodwork Wonders' in a rejuvenated warehouse on Baker Street on October 15, 2023, selling custom handcrafted furniture and offering workshops and apprentice programs.
Rachel Simmons opened 'Read-It-Forward Bookshop' on December 1, 2023, using a 'pay it forward' model where readers leave books for others, each with a note from the previous reader.
Eli Thompson and Misha Patel founded 'Sensory Spa,' which opened on September 30, 2023, and combines therapies engaging sight, sound, touch and smell.
Zoe Mitchell unveiled her 'Green Gym' on October 27, 2023; its equipment converts kinetic energy from workouts into electricity that powers the facility.
Kevin Hart and Julie Chen both have backgrounds in interior design and technology and aim to make home design less intimidating and accessible regardless of budget or expertise.
